Class SoccerPlayer

java.lang.Object
SoccerPlayer
public class SoccerPlayer extends Object
Jean Roudy Alexis CEN - 3024C - 23585 - Software Development 1 March 3, 2026 SoccerPlayer.java This class represents a soccer player and stores player information such as ID, name, team, position, matches played, goals, assists, and minutes played. It also calculates player performance statistics.
